articles.headline: Duke star Cam Boozer says he suffered fractures around eye
articles.description: Duke's Cameron Boozer, a projected top-five pick in the 2026 NBA draft, said he suffered multiple fractures around one of his eyes during his team's loss to UConn in the Elite Eight.

articles.headline: Caleb Foster's 'incredible' return has Jon Scheyer, Duke raving
articles.description: Caleb Foster returned from a broken foot and rescued Duke's national title hopes, helping the top-seeded Blue Devils rally from a 10-point second-half deficit to beat St. John's 80-75.
